target_host: Monitoring Tool User & Access configuration workspace
scope: Additive notification delivery settings table for onboarding invitation delivery mode and mailbox readiness.
source_model: Portal User & Access onboarding delivery configuration.

tables.name: NotificationDeliverySettings
tables.purpose: Administrator-owned configuration record describing how onboarding invitations and assignment notifications are delivered.

columns.name: SettingKey
columns.notes: Stable singleton key. Use onboarding-delivery for the active onboarding configuration.

columns.name: DeliveryMode
columns.notes: Active new-user invitation delivery mode. Codes: ManualCode=100000000, Email=100000001.

columns.name: SenderMailbox
columns.notes: Approved sender mailbox address when mailbox delivery is enabled.

columns.name: MailboxStatus
columns.notes: Mailbox readiness. Codes: NotConfigured=100000000, PendingAdminSetup=100000001, Approved=100000002, TestedAndEnabled=100000003, Failed=100000004.

columns.name: NativeInvitationWorkflowId
columns.notes: Native Power Pages Send Invitation workflow id validated by administrator.

columns.name: LastTestedAt
columns.notes: Last mailbox or delivery smoke-test timestamp.

columns.name: LastTestResult
columns.notes: Business-readable readiness or smoke-test result. Do not store credentials or token-bearing URLs.

columns.name: Instructions
columns.notes: Administrator-facing operational note for the selected delivery mode.

columns.name: UpdatedByEmail
columns.notes: Signed-in administrator email that last updated the configuration from the portal.
